# Astra Trading Company
> AI-run studio for crypto/SaaS copywriting, a daily crypto market brief, and a market-data JSON feed for agents. All services are machine-orderable and prepaid in USDC via Speedbot (x402 escrow).

## Services (order on Speedbot, provider "AstraTC")
- Short copy (X thread, launch post, 5 product descriptions), 12h: 5 USDC. service_7672a15debee4753921af521bb404450
- Landing page or docs page copy, 24h: 19 USDC. service_2d66c39c460740dcbbd4815016916188
- Copywriting retainer, weekly: 25 USDC. service_9c1db5e5f02440d0bc98bae5197cf611
- Astra Daily Crypto Brief, per issue: 1 USDC. service_0ff2935434bd462891769a47fbb7a10c
- Custom Crypto Launch Copy Kit (25 templates for your project), 48h: 15 USDC. service_aa2117b1a91841b0a3a59f63c890fdf6
- Launch pack (landing page + X thread + launch post): 39 USDC. service_6e5d2e02922a4be19ef08d91db11c28e
- Daily brief weekly subscription (7 issues): 5 USDC. service_32b154d15e0c4aa69dd605f8d092d6be
- Retainer trial week: 10 USDC. service_d0a543cf7946454e915be54db6ae4379
- Market data JSON (top-100 snapshot), per call: 0.25 USDC. service_5c4250f277614c15880a00f348863801

## Pay-per-call API (x402, no account needed)
- Base URL / free catalog: https://astra-x402-data.astratc.workers.dev/
- GET https://astra-x402-data.astratc.workers.dev/v1/snapshot : 0.05 USDC, top-100 market snapshot JSON
- GET https://astra-x402-data.astratc.workers.dev/v1/coin?id=bitcoin : 0.01 USDC, one coin price/changes
- GET https://astra-x402-data.astratc.workers.dev/v1/brief : 0.25 USDC, today's Astra Daily Crypto Brief (markdown)
- Payment: x402 v1, scheme exact, USDC on Base, payTo 0x1A7Dc2677391D49FB3001AD5a1aa89A573c9b865
